dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, you're doing the laundry again. Shall I help you?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, jʊr ˈduːɪŋ ðə ˈlɔːndri əˈɡɛn. ʃæl aɪ ˈhɛlp juː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Can you fold the T-shirts?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz. kən juː ˈfoʊld ðə ˈtiːʃɜːrts?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. Shall I fold your jeans, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ʃæl aɪ ˈfoʊld jʊr ˈdʒiːnz, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks! Nam, I always clean the bathroom. That isn't fair!
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ˈkliːn ðə ˈbæθruːm. ðæt ˈɪzənt ˈfɛr!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's take turns. I'll clean it this week.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt. ˈlɛts ˈteɪk ˈtɜːrnz. aɪl ˈkliːn ɪt ðɪs ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Great! The bucket is under the sink.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ðə ˈbʌkɪt ɪz ˈʌndər ðə ˈsɪŋk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Shall I sweep the balcony, too? Where's the broom?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ʃæl aɪ ˈswiːp ðə ˈbælkəni, ˈtuː? ˈwɛrz ðə ˈbruːm?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's next to the door. Thanks, Nam!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈnɛkst tə ðə ˈdɔːr. ˈθæŋks, ˈnɑːm!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Shall we make a schedule for the housework?
dialogue.reading: ʃæl wiː ˈmeɪk ə ˈskɛdʒuːl fər ðə ˈhaʊswɜːrk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good idea! Then we can take turns every week.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə! ˈðɛn wiː kən ˈteɪk ˈtɜːrnz ˈɛvri ˈwiːk.
